title: Guess the next character
description: The first steps of a language model in six small stations: guess the next character yourself, turn text into numbers, count what follows a character, generate text by rolling weighted dice, see how one snippet holds many training examples, and retrain on your own text.

stations.title: Generating text, one character at a time

changelog: First half of next-char-lab 2.1.0, split so that each simulator has at most seven stations (PEDAGOGY.md §5). English and German UI; every experiment starts with a prediction that is judged after the result (SIMULATOR-SPEC §7 rule 5); starts in focus mode with a progress row; canvas-free; full state is saved and restored. The loss, training curve, temperature and table stations moved to bigram-lab.
